source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Fresh complete one-file30-line signing configuration patch read. It adds the same /Contents/MacOS/crashhelper path to the production hardened-signing group whose comment says without entitlements, and to the default group with developer utility entitlements. Fixed accepted source keeps the two distinct groups; current utility entitlement artifact paths have since changed to public/build/security/utility.xml. The identical glob does not imply identical entitlements. Full Bug 0–6 and complete zero-inline review read. Early lint/upstream regression guesses and a crashreporter wording slip are not used as the accepted executable identity; the actual patch adds crashhelper after2454 packaging. Author explicitly could not run the signing Try because the decision task lacked signing worker/certificate scopes. Reviewer accepts despite that limit; failed/ongoing build status and landing are not a signing pass.
title: The same macOS executable can have different keyed signing entitlements
